sources.title: GitHub - aimerib/spoomplesmaxx
sources.snippet: These datasets are designed to train a Roleplay (RP), Creative Writing, and "Smart" Assistant model Spoomplesmaxx. The goal of combining these specific sets is to create a model that is narratively creative and capable of embodying characters, but also logically sound and capable of following complex instructions.

sources.title: aimeri/spoomplesmaxx-mini-14B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SpoomplesMaxx is a generalist model with primary strengths in creative writing and roleplay, plus light competence at instruction following and reasoning. The Mini brings the v2.1 data and training recipe to a 14B you can run on a single 24GB card. Smaller bird, same energy.

sources.title: aimeri/spoomplesmaxx-magpie-35B-A3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SpoomplesMaxx is a generalist model with primary strengths in creative writing and roleplay, plus competence at instruction following, reasoning, and tool calling. Magpie is Jackdaw with a preference pass on top: same SFT, then DPO on ~11K judged preference pairs weighted toward prose quality, character voice, and staying in persona.

sources.title: GitHub - aimerib/spoomples-spot-instance
sources.snippet: Spot Instance Training Setup for Spoomplesmaxx Automated training on Vast.ai spot instances with checkpoint sync to Backblaze B2.
